_comment: Syracuse — nine-stage-generation workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Syracuse, NY MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 3 MSA counties (Onondaga, Madison, Oswego), Madison (New York), Oswego (New York)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 15 geocoded venue(s) of 15 in this batch (observed lat 42.9978..43.1410, lng -76.3350..-75.9822).
_reconcile_comment: One venue matches a dormant source='osm' status='draft' row, adjudicated SAME venue by court-verifier on 2026-07-31. UPDATE keyed on osm_id, never an INSERT. The reconcile moves the row's city from Syracuse to DeWitt (and its slug with it) because the research row places the venue in DeWitt; the target is a draft that was never public, so there is no URL-stability cost and no redirect obligation.

reconciles.note: SAME venue as the dormant OSM row (0 m — the research row's own geocode resolved to this exact OSM node, same name). The OSM row is access_type='unknown'; the reconcile patches it to the research value 'public' on the venue's own site. NOTE the research row carries NO address and no zip, so the reconcile leaves address NULL where the OSM row had '3179 Erie Boulevard East'; that is the honest outcome of the artifact and not a defect to paper over — the publish gate does not require an address, and the coordinate is high-precision.

same_site_pairs.note: Both carry the address 1 Arkie Albanese Ave and geocode to 0 m, so this pair MUST be adjudicated or one row publishes as a duplicate pin. Two venues on one site — the same shape as syr-meachem/syr-cecile below. The Village of Manlius built SIX outdoor public courts on the old soccer field between Willowbrook Drive and the Manlius Village Centre, ribbon-cut July 2026 at just under $400,000 (Eagle News / CNY Central); the Manlius Recreation Center is the building itself and offers ONE indoor court, members only (cnypickleball.com). Different court sets, different settings, different access classes. If the name-separation pass cannot resolve the 2026 outdoor build — it may not be in OSM yet — HOLD syr-manlius-rec rather than publish two pins at one point: the 6-court public venue is the one that matters to a user.
same_site_pairs._batch_note: Both members are v3-pass rows and therefore import under batch syracuse-v3-2026-08-06, not syracuse-2026-07-31. This entry is duplicated into scripts/metros/syracuse-v3.json, which is the config that actually imports them; it is kept here only so the shared extract runs the name-separation pass.

same_site_pairs.note: The City of Syracuse pickleball page lists them under two different headings. Meachem Field appears under Outdoor Courts ("Meachem Field (3 courts, lights available for evening play)"), where "Play is First Come First Play". Bob Cecile is a senior center whose only pickleball offering is under Lessons and Clinics: "Cecile Center, 174 W. Seneca Trpk, 13205: Wednesdays and Fridays, 12 to 12:45 p.m.", 55+ with a senior membership. Same rec-center-inside-a-park shape as Des Moines, confirmed at tier 1 rather than assumed; they geocode 83 m apart onto their own distinct house numbers (121 vs 174 W Seneca Turnpike).

_venue_facts_comment: syr-cecile only. Magnarelli is deliberately LEFT at access_type='unknown': the same city page gives it BOTH an open 17+ "Adult Pick Up Play - Indoor" program AND a separate 55+ senior-membership Open Play, so it genuinely mixes two access classes and 'unknown' is the honest answer, not a gap. Do not 'fix' it.

syr-cecile.reason: the city page's only pickleball offering at the Cecile Center is Senior Lessons, and it states one access class outright: "Players must be at least 55 years of age and have a senior membership"

access_type.reason: workbook left it 'unknown'; the controlling entity names a single unambiguous access class (55+ senior membership), which is ruling-1 branch 1 — take it

coordinate.reason: OSM carries the venue itself as leisure/park way/336908450 "Skyway Park", containing four sport=pickleball pitches (way/1416783511-14). The query ladder cannot reach it: OSM has no house number 5950 on East Taft Road, so every address rung falls back to the East Taft Road centreline 2,283 m away and classifies low. The superseded anchor is therefore a STREET BAND — Nominatim matched the right road NAME and returned the wrong SEGMENT — which is why the 1000 m anchor guard does not apply and the envelope + zip-locus fence does.

OSM carries the venue itself as leisure/park way/419320185 "Van Buren Central Park", with two sport=pickleball pitches (way/1503982599, way/1503982600) inside its recreation_ground. The query ladder cannot reach it: OSM has no house number 7350 on Canton Street, so every address rung falls back to the Canton Street centreline 2,529 m away and classifies low. The superseded anchor is a STREET BAND, so the adoption is fenced by the metro envelope and the venue's 13027 zip locus rather than by distance from the road.
